claim_as_stated: Registry-centered formal multi-actor administrative architecture, bounded to the selected microcase. Claim level: architecture, cross_provision_inference. Problem/scale: administration of phased registration, prior-right validation, continuity arrangement, and the limited ADR interface within the selected provisions. Within the ten authorized anchors, P04 formally distributes administrative work through a Registry-centered set of relationships with specialized external actors, subject to narrowly specified Commission involvement. The claim remains a formal, bounded architecture; it makes no implementation, performance, or regime claim.
inferential_warrant: Configurations: [ref] (auditor appointment/consultation), [ref] (delegated validation), [ref] (conditional escrow continuity), and [ref] (partial ADR-provider interface). Qualified coupling: the Registry is the expressly identified party in appointment, consultation, validation-agent selection and requirement, escrow agreement, daily submission, and ADR-provider selection. The Commission has narrowly specified consultative/consent roles; external validation agents, escrow agents, auditors, and ADR providers perform differentiated functions. Attributes: Registry’s capacities are function-specific rather than generalized; validation agents have limited assessment function; Commission consent is agreement-specific. Accountability is not promoted from reporting/information alone. Architectural significance: Registry centrality is supported by direct, functionally diverse, and repeated legal relations across the bounded configurations, not merely a mention count.
counter_evidence_alternatives_and_declin: Boundary and alternative: the claim is limited to the frozen P04 microcase. A competing reading—separate unconnected administrative fragments—was assessed. It is weaker because the Registry directly connects the configurations through multiple legal capacities and instruments. The broader reading—architecture of the entire .eu domain regime—is rejected as beyond the sample.
stopping_and_boundary_statement: No claim is made about system-wide intermediary centrality, because indispensability, substitutability, and the omitted portions of the Regulation are not evidenced in this freeze.
